skills.name: Bowling
skills.description: Rolls bowling balls to attack enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *ATK x 3300% Area Damage  *Continuously cancels enemy buffs (5 sec)

skills.name: I'm Gonna Crush All Of You!
skills.description: Shouts out to go all out. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (5 sec) *Removes allies' debuffs (5 sec) *ATK +330% (5 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Tokyo Revengers
abilities.description: Tokyo Revengers Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Ally Clone
abilities.description: Has a set chance of summoning 1 allied team Ranger when Rangers deploy.　  - Flyer and Air Ambush Rangers are not eligible to be summoned in this way.  - The Abilities of allied Rangers summoned by this Ability won't activate. - Summoned Rangers won't consume any Mineral and will have no effects on redeploy times.
